title: Fishtank for TransWall++
summary: An interactive virtual aquarium for TransWall++, a transparent display that responds to touch from both sides.
Virtual jellyfish glow, make sounds, and drift with currents created by visitors' touch.

paragraph: Fishtank for TransWall++ turns a transparent display into a shared virtual aquarium, allowing visitors on either side to interact with jellyfish while seeing one another through the screen.
The design embraces the display's inability to render fully opaque objects: translucent jellyfish make transparency a natural part of the underwater scene.
The jellyfish glow and produce sounds when touched, while dragging a hand across the glass creates currents that guide their movement.
The fishtank was presented on TransWall++ for the opening of Nexperium at Shinsegae Art & Science in Daejeon, South Korea, in August 2021.

Its approximately 90-inch transparent display combines infrared touch sensing, holographic screen film, and two ultra-short-throw projectors to support interaction from both sides, with surface transducers providing tactile feedback.
